prompt: Create a vertical 2:3 cinematic fantasy character illustration of an elven aetheric surveyor standing full-body in a grand gothic steampunk observatory. She is a refined young woman with long windswept emerald green hair, pale skin, pointed ears, elegant serious expression, and detailed anime-realism facial features. Outfit: dark emerald Victorian military coat with gold embroidery and trim, high ruffled cream blouse, fitted black trousers, belts, pouches, brass instruments, black gloves, tall black leather heeled boots with ornate gold buckles, and a long layered cape lined in cream fabric. Behind her are exactly eight large translucent crystalline wing-like shards radiating from her back, faceted and glowing pale mint green like cut glass. In her left hand she holds a tall ornate staff topped with a large green crystal spearhead framed by gold filigree; with her right hand she touches a floating holographic interface panel. The hologram is a luminous green transparent rectangular sci-fi magic screen containing exactly five main information areas: 1) top title text reading AETHERIC SURVEY // LAYER 7, 2) an upper-left circular compass/radar diagram, 3) an upper-right irregular map silhouette, 4) a lower-left circular status gauge reading STABLE +0.37%, and 5) a lower-right analysis card labeled LEYLINE FLUX ANALYSIS with small charts and data lines. Background: towering arched windows, dark cathedral columns, brass pipes, gears, mechanical astrolabe machinery, misty volumetric light, polished stone floor with reflections. Color palette of deep green, black, antique gold, pale crystal mint, and smoky gray. Style: highly detailed fantasy concept art, sharp linework blended with painterly realism, luxurious costume design, glowing magical technology, dramatic rim light, depth of field, intricate textures, no watermark, no extra characters.

promptZh: 创作一张 2:3 比例的竖版电影感奇幻角色插画，画面中 一位精灵以太勘测员 全身站立在一座宏伟的哥特式蒸汽朋克天文台中。她是一位气质高雅的年轻女性，留着随风飘动的 翡翠绿色长发，肤色苍白，有着尖耳朵、优雅而严肃的表情，以及精致的动漫写实风格面部特征。服装：深翡翠色维多利亚军装外套，配有金色刺绣和镶边，高领褶皱奶油色衬衫，修身黑色长裤，腰带，小包，黄铜仪器，黑色手套，带有华丽金扣的高筒黑色皮靴，以及内衬为奶油色面料的长款分层斗篷。她身后有八片巨大的半透明水晶状羽翼，从背部放射而出，呈现出切割玻璃般的淡薄荷绿色光芒。她的左手握着一根高大的华丽法杖，杖顶镶嵌着由金丝装饰的巨大绿色水晶矛头；右手触碰着一个悬浮的全息界面面板。全息图是一个发光的绿色透明矩形科幻魔法屏幕，包含五个主要信息区域：1) 顶部标题文字显示为 AETHERIC SURVEY // LAYER 7，2) 左上角的圆形指南针/雷达图，3) 右上角的不规则地图轮廓，4) 左下角的圆形状态仪表，读数为 STABLE +0.37%，以及 5) 右下角的分析卡片，标注为 LEYLINE FLUX ANALYSIS，配有小型图表和数据线。背景：高耸的拱形窗户、深色大教堂立柱、黄铜管道、齿轮、机械星盘装置、朦胧的体积光、带有倒影的抛光石地板。色调：深绿、黑、古金、淡薄荷晶体色和烟灰色。风格：高度细致的奇幻概念艺术，锐利的线条与写实绘画风格融合，奢华的服装设计，发光的魔法科技，戏剧性的轮廓光，景深效果，复杂的纹理，无水印，无多余角色。
